name: Hodasarete... ~Karate Musume Chizuru no Jouji~
original_name: 絆されて・・・～空手娘・千鶴の情事～
source:
Chizuru Kamiya is the only daughter of the Kamiya Dojo. She lost her mother when she was young and now helps her father protect the dojo. She is healthy and cheerful, with a personality that gets completely absorbed in anything related to karate. Her goal is to surpass her father and inherit the dojo.

Tomoki Okuta, who was saved from bullies as a child by Chizuru, she said: "If you want to get strong, come with me!" and led him to the Kamiya Dojo. For the 10 years since, he has been training as a student there. Initially, he just wanted to get stronger. But over time, he developed feelings for Chizuru, and now he continues karate just to be by her side.

Go to school, train at the dojo, and break a sweat.
A daily routine that hadn't changed for 10 years.
However, when this routine is shattered, the story is set in motion.
translation:
神谷千鹤是神谷道场的独生女。她年幼时失去了母亲，如今帮助父亲守护道场。她健康开朗，对空手道相关的一切都十分投入。她的目标是超越父亲，继承道场。

大久田智树小时候曾被千鹤从霸凌者手中救下。千鹤对他说：“想变强的话，就跟我来！”随后带他来到神谷道场。此后的十年间，他一直作为学生在那里训练。最初，他只是想变得更强，但随着时间推移，他对千鹤产生了感情，如今继续练习空手道，只是为了待在她身边。

上学、在道场训练、挥洒汗水。
十年来从未改变的日常。
然而，当这套日常被打破时，故事开始转动。
